properties.name: Addis Ababa–Djibouti Railway
properties.costNote: Widely reported total for both countries' sections; not an audited figure.
properties.summary: 752 km electrified standard-gauge line operated by Ethio-Djibouti Railway (EDR). Commercial service since 2018. EDR plans to raise freight capacity from 2 Mt to 6.2 Mt a year by 2027 and to link more Djibouti terminals by end-2026.
properties.geometryNote: Track geometry from OpenStreetMap (435 mapped segments, about 722 km, simplified). Status comes from the cited sources, not from the map.

properties.name: Addis–Djibouti road corridor (via Galafi)
funders: Multiple (World Bank, AfDB, EU and national budgets over several decades)
properties.summary: Main truck route for Ethiopia's imports via Djibouti. A 2026 fuel shortage slowed trucking on this corridor and shifted some cargo to rail.

properties.name: Addis Ababa Bole International Airport
properties.summary: Ethiopian Airlines' hub. Reported annual capacity ranges from 20 to 25 million passengers depending on the source; the domestic terminal is being expanded.

properties.name: Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam
funders: Government of Ethiopia (public bonds and domestic contributions)
properties.summary: 5,150 MW hydropower dam on the Blue Nile, inaugurated 9 September 2025. Egypt and Sudan dispute its operation.

properties.name: Ethiopia–Kenya 500 kV HVDC interconnector
properties.summary: 1,045 km line rated 2,000 MW. Kenya imported about 200 MW; a July 2026 supply agreement sets up a rise to 400 MW, reported for December 2026.

properties.name: Ethiopia–Djibouti power interconnection (first line)
properties.summary: 230 kV line supplying Djibouti from the Ethiopian grid; reported to be near its transfer limit, which is why a second line is planned.

connects: Addis Ababa (planned rail and road links)
properties.summary: Construction launched 10 January 2026; earthworks under way. Main contractor selection moved to early 2027. Phase one targeted for 2030, up to 110 million passengers a year at full build.
